title: The Vanishing Couriers
summary: Trusted messengers carrying blood, secrets, and paper boons are disappearing before dawn.
stakes: If the pattern continues, the domain's economy of obligation fractures.

title: Ghost Station Ledger
summary: A transit node closed to the public still shows encrypted movement tied to dead feeding grounds.
stakes: Whoever controls the ledger can expose havens, routes, and herd assets.

title: Thin-Blood Livestream
summary: Someone is staging near-masquerade breaches as viral performances that keep vanishing after they spread.
stakes: Stop it too slowly and hunters notice; stop it too brutally and the streets ignite.

title: Elysium Restoration Contract
summary: A sacred venue is being renovated by a mortal firm with the wrong sort of curiosity.
stakes: Save the site, exploit the project, or let an enemy weaponize the workers and plans.
